name: Rupa Rao

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rupa Rao is a poet and editor whose writing has appeared in Different Truths and Setu. Trained in business and law in Mumbai, she also brings writers together through poetry sessions and collaborative anthologies. With C. A. MacKenzie, she compiled Whispers of Spring’s Serenade, an English-language anthology published by MacKenzie Publishing.

“Soundless Shrieks” centres children left vulnerable by war and displacement. Its movement from stunned silence to a direct appeal for compassion refuses to let children disappear into statistics. Repeated end sounds give urgency to the poem’s plea for shelter, security and peace.
